fact: Guinea-Bissau's national report to the 2025 UPR lists the personal data protection bill among several bills awaiting discussion in the National Popular Assembly (ANP), whose inaction is blocking key legislation.
title: A/HRC/WG.6/49/GNB/1 : Rapport national de la Guinée-Bissau
publisher: Conseil des droits de l'homme des Nations Unies, Groupe de travail sur l'Examen périodique universel
